paper_title: MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio,   Music, and Their Mix
caption: : Task Taxonomy
model_annotation: This chart presents a hierarchical task taxonomy displayed as a multi-ring (sunburst) donut chart, illustrating the distribution of tasks across different layers and subcategories related to deep reasoning in speech, audio, and music. The inner ring is divided into four main layers: the Semantic Layer, shown in a medium blue, occupying the largest portion at 41.2%; the Perception Layer, depicted in a darker blue, representing 40.4%; the Cultural Layer, shown in a lighter blue-gray, at 14.1%; and the Signal Layer, displayed in a medium-dark blue, comprising the smallest share at 4.3%. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each inner-ring slice. The outer ring further subdivides these layers into more specific task categories. Under the Semantic Layer, the outer ring includes Content Analysis (the largest outer segment), Emotion & Intention, and Speaker Analysis. Under the Perception Layer, the outer subcategories include Environmental Perception & Reasoning (the largest in this group), Counting & Statistics, Music Theory, Correlation Analysis, Temporal Analysis, and Spatial Analysis. Under the Cultural Layer, the outer segments include Culture of Speaker, Professional Knowledge & Reasoning, Aesthetic Analysis, and Imagination. Under the Signal Layer, the subcategories shown are Acoustic Quality Analysis, Anomaly/Detection, and Audio Difference Analysis. The outer ring segments use varying shades of blue and gray that correspond to their parent inner-ring layer, with darker shades generally associated with the Perception Layer and lighter shades with the Cultural and Signal Layers. The subcategory labels are placed directly on or adjacent to their respective slices, with font sizes roughly proportional to the segment size. The segments within each layer appear to be ordered roughly by decreasing size in a clockwise direction. No separate legend is provided; all labeling is integrated into the chart itself.
